# Marieliez Pharmacy

> Neighbourhood pharmacy in Cairo, Egypt, with branches in Nasr City (Al Golf) and New Cairo (Highland Park Mall). Prescriptions, medication counseling, wellness products, dermocosmetics, WhatsApp ordering, and priority handling for urgent needs.

## Areas served

East Cairo and New Cairo compounds and neighbourhoods near Highland Park, including Akoya, SODIC Eastown, Villette, Kattameya Plaza, and EDNC, plus Nasr City / Al Golf. Confirm delivery coverage by WhatsApp when ordering.

## Services

- Prescription fills and refills
- Medication counseling (dosing, interactions, use)
- Everyday wellness essentials
- Online catalog browsing with WhatsApp checkout
- Priority handling for urgent / emergency orders
- Dermocosmetics and haircare (Vichy, Kérastase, La Roche-Posay, L'Oréal, and peer lines)

## How to order

1. Browse https://marieliezpharmacy.com/#shop
2. Add products to the cart
3. Send the order on WhatsApp (+20 112 111 1605)
4. For emergencies, WhatsApp or call the same number immediately
